By Darrelle Lincoln ,

A football player being transported by ambulance (Andy Abeyta/The Desert Sun-USA TODAY NETWORK via Imagn Images) Four college football players, including Parker Sutherland, have all tragically lost their lives this offseason.
It has gotten so bad that the United States has issued safety warnings for all young athletes. According to the alert, immediate response to medical emergencies can be lifesaving. Bystanders should be prepared to act without hesitation. The guidance emphasizes that doing something in an emergency is better than doing nothing.
‚ÄúDoing something is always better than doing nothing,‚Äù the warning states, per The Spun.
‚ÄúCardiac emergencies can happen anywhere ‚Äì in classrooms, during athletic events, or while walking across campus. Studies show that immediate CPR can double or even triple a person‚Äôs chance of survival, yet many people hesitate to help because they fear they lack proper training. Hands-only CPR eliminates that barrier. No rescue breaths required ‚Äì just two simple steps,‚Äù the full warning reads.
Earlier this week, the University of Northern Iowa announced that Parker Sutherland died at age 18 . The college football player played for the Panthers for just one season, playing in four games. Northern Iowa‚Äôs athletic department shared the news on Saturday. ‚ÄúI‚Äôm heartbroken,‚Äù head coach Todd Stepsis said in a school news release.
His death marked the fourth young athlete to tragically lose their life at a young age.
Who Were The Other College Football Players who Lost Their Lives MINNEAPOLIS, MN ‚Äì AUGUST 30: Footballs are seen before the game between the Minnesota Golden Gophers and the New Mexico State Aggies (Photo by Hannah Foslien/Getty Images) It has been a rough few months for college athletes all over the country. Being an athlete is not easy, and not everybody might make it to the pros, but nobody should lose their lives over it or by any other means.
Earlier this offseason, 20-year-old lineman Ethan Walker, an offensive lineman for the Iowa Central Tritons, passed away unexpectedly on January 4, 2026. He was on vacation in Orlando, Florida. The college football player died unexpectedly while on vacation with his girlfriend‚Äôs family.
The couple was accompanied by Kenzie‚Äôs parents, ‚Äúwhom Ethan had become very close with over the years, having been such a loving and devoted partner who honored their daughter with every action,‚Äù per a GoFundMe.
Southeast Missouri State University kicker Danny Duray also passed away at age 20. After redshirting with the Redhawks in his freshman year, Duray spent 2025 playing as a member of the College of DuPage Chaparrals. Duray was a two-time NJCAA special teams player of the week during the 2025 football season and scored 62 points as the team‚Äôs kicker.
Izaiah Taylor, an offensive lineman for Georgia Military College, died just before Christmas. The college football player died in a house fire in suburban Atlanta. He was home from school for the winter break and staying at his grandfather‚Äôs residence.
The offensive lineman joined the junior college team this season after playing for Liberty University in 2024.
Prayers to all of the college football players who have passed away.
